steps.action: Commit on hostile or unknown tracks entering the sweep area below flight level 350.
Do not pursue south of the Cobalt kill box while it is open.
Check in with Warhawk: mission number, aircraft, position and altitude, ordnance, playtime, abort code.
Receive the situation update and the JTAC assignment.
steps.completion: Warhawk hands the flight to Axeman.

steps.action: Authenticate the DZ support team with the number of the day before the one-minute call.
Drop only on green smoke at the raised angle marker.
Fire only at emitters of the SA-6 battery inside the Cobalt kill box.
Call the missile shot on the Anvil package frequency.
Debrief at Muwaffaq Salti 1700Z with weapons-system video and the JTAC log.
Leave the operating area via Cedar; contact Banshee.
Authenticate the survivor with the SARNEG word and the number of the day.
Survivor marks with day smoke or an infrared strobe at night.
Contact Shell on the tanker frequency 20 nautical miles from Shell anchor.
Join 1000 feet below the tanker's flight level, then climb to pre-contact when cleared.
Call knock-it-off on Darkstar control for any safety concern.
Keep 1000 feet vertical or 1 nautical mile horizontal from other aircraft in a merge.

contingencies: If no holding level is available, remain below 12000 feet MSL and follow Darkstar instructions.
